current_prompt.body:
READ the privacy policy excerpt.
FOR EACH statement IN the excerpt:
  MAP the statement TO relevant GDPR article(s).
END_FOR
IDENTIFY GDPR requirements THAT ARE NOT ADDRESSED BY ANY statement.
RETURN the statement-to-article mapping AND the list of uncovered GDPR requirements.
